title: Implement panelized GF(p) PLE/LU — small-prime family (026fc832 Phase 6)
description:
Phase 6 implementation task under epic `026fc832`. Implements the panelized GF(p) PLE/LU kernel per the design in `2e8c5a29`.

Parent epic: `026fc832`. Predecessor: `2e8c5a29` (design).

## Background

Implements the design approved under `2e8c5a29`. Closes A8 rows 6-17, 71 (pluq cells over GF(7/251/65521) and GF(31)).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] Production code implementing the panelized PLE per the approved design at `dev/active/<2e8c5a29-...>-design.md`.
- [hard] Bit-exact correctness vs the existing scalar PLE on a proptest sweep across GF(7), GF(31), GF(127), GF(241), GF(251), GF(65521) at boundary lengths {0, 1, 15, 16, 17, 63, 64, 65} plus rank-deficient cases. Uses `proptest!` macros.
- [hard] 5-trial CCX1-pinned benchmarks on the 5900X reference host at n in {64, 256, 1024} for each of the 6 small primes, both uniform and rank-deficient regimes. Recorded as CSV + evidence doc.
- [hard] Every A8 pluq cell (rows 6-17, 71) either PASSes (ratio ≤ 1.5× vs fflas) or carries an explicit user-approved [aspirational] amendment. Escalate cells that don't cross the threshold.
- [hard] No regression on currently-PASSing GF(p) cells (delta ≤ 5%). 
- [hard] No `unsafe` outside `gf2-kernels-simd` / `gf2-kernels-hip`. `gf2-core` remains `#![deny(unsafe_code)]`.
- [hard] Reuses the SSOT helpers named in the design (`barrett_reduce_lane32`, panel size constants).

## Out of scope

- Echelon/invert/solve implementations (sibling tasks; depend on this).
- Mersenne31 PLE (not in scope of the design).
